death.note: al-Maqrīzī recorded his death in the year "one" (سنة احدى) = 801 H (NOT 901 — al-Maqrīzī died in 845 H and could not have recorded a 901 death; the bare year is read as 801 per al-Sakhāwī's frame).

event.note: al-Maqrīzī recorded/dated his death to the year 801 H (Pattern A mention).

person.note: بغا الحسني نائب حمص ، أرخه المقريزي في سنة احدى .
バガー・アル＝ハサニー。ホムス（ヒムス）の副総督（ナーイブ）。アル＝マクリーズィーは彼の死を（ヒジュラ暦）801年と記録した。
Bughā al-Ḥasanī, deputy governor (nāʾib) of Ḥimṣ. al-Maqrīzī recorded his death in the year 801 H.
